ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels to 35% low-intensity black pixels, concentrated in a central dark region and distal borders.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity contiguous region centered at the notch extending horizontally across the lower third of both lobes. Right lobe features high-density black mottling and speckling in the lower quadrant. Left lobe presents a clean high-intensity field bordered by a continuous low-intensity band along the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped depression with an approximate angle of 60 degrees; depth occupies roughly one-quarter of the vertical fluke profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge. Right lobe tip shows extreme jaggedness with pixel-amplitude spikes of 8-12 units. Left lobe edge contains smaller, more uniform micro-notches.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve with initial concavity at the notch transitioning to broad convexity toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense cluster of roughly circular high-contrast nodules on the extreme right distal tip. Secondary cluster of small white-on-black circular spots along the dorsal-facing margin of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark diagonal linear streaks on the left lobe, including a prominent 'X' pattern of intersecting scratches. Vertical rake marks detected in the upper white region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme irregular erosion/encrustation at the right lobe tip, resulting in a localized loss of linear edge continuity.
